article.title: Common mistake: 'I am agree' vs 'I agree'
article.description: Wrong: 'I am agree with you.' Right: 'I agree with you.' Teaching point: 'agree' is already a verb in English, unlike some languages where the equivalent is an adjective/state requiring 'to be'. No 'am/is/are' needed before 'agree'.
article.content: Wrong: 'I am agree with you.' Right: 'I agree with you.' Teaching point: 'agree' is already a verb in English, unlike some languages where the equivalent is an adjective/state requiring 'to be'. No 'am/is/are' needed before 'agree'.

generated.caption:
Ever said "I am agree" and felt something wasn't quite right? 🤔 You're not alone! Many learners make this common mistake.

In English, 'agree' is a verb all by itself – it doesn't need 'am', 'is', or 'are' in front of it. Just like in "I walk" or "I eat".

So, simply say: "I agree with you." ✨

Save this quick tip for next time! Follow @EnglishVault for more daily English lessons!
generated.script: Aapne bhi kabhi 'I am agree' bola hai kya? Ye sunke thoda weird lagta hai na? Kyunki ye ek common mistake hai jo hum karte hain. Dekho, 'agree' already ek verb hai English mein. Matlab ek action word. Jaise 'eat', 'sleep', 'run'. Hum 'I am eat' ya 'I am sleep' nahi bolte na? Waise hi, 'agree' ke pehle 'am' ya 'is' ya 'are' ki koi zaroorat nahi hoti. Kayi languages mein iska equivalent ek adjective hota hai jiske liye 'to be' verb lagta hai, but English mein 'agree' khud hi ek verb hai. Toh correct usage hai: 'I agree with you'. Toh yaad rakho, next time se, simply 'I agree' bolo, 'I am agree' nahi. Ab samajh aaya? Comment mein batao aapko ye mistake pata thi ya nahi! Aur aise hi English tips ke liye follow karo The English Vault!

slides.body: Many English learners, especially those whose native language uses an adjective to express agreement, might naturally say 'I am agree.' However, 'agree' is already a verb in English, meaning 'to have the same opinion.' This means it doesn't need an auxiliary verb like 'am,' 'is,' or 'are' before it. So, instead of the incorrect 'I am agree with you,' the correct and natural way to express agreement is 'I agree with you.' Remember to use 'agree' directly as a verb, just like 'I understand.'
slides.hindiSummary: 'Agree' एक क्रिया है, इसलिए इसके साथ 'am' का उपयोग न करें, बल्कि सीधे 'I agree' कहें।
